version_records.name: Pipeline biomethane procurement eligibility AB70
version_records.application: Annual jurisdiction recovered-organic-product procurement target eligibility; potentially applicable where public-owner maintenance/work purchases qualifying biomethane fuel for fleets or equipment. Does not impose a general private-owner procurement duty or make target accounting a universal product standard.

version_records.legal_status: Approved emergency except section18660.34(c), filed and printed under Government Code11343.8. Distinct from annual 2027 recycling-fee proposal.
version_records.applicability: Conditional covered-product disposal, collector/recycler/manufacturer duties and reimbursement; not a general tenant disposal-charge authorization. Retained mixed CalRecycle division includes downstream materials handling.

version_records.legal_status: Permanent approval confirmed by OAL action table and agency; follows timelyJanuary20,2026 certificate submission before statedFebruary12 emergency expiration.
source_conflicts: PDF retains PROPOSED REGULATION TEXT/emergency header, but both OAL and agency specifically link it as approved permanent text.
Agency landing affected-sections paragraph omits new17862.4 and other final additions; OAL final inventory controls with document reconciliation.
OAL summary prints17869.45; actualapprovedPDF sectionheading is17896.45.
version_records.application: Illegal-disposal enforcement can reach parties causing, arranging, transporting or accepting disposal; land-application/compost provider standards and conditional public-owner mulch procurement. Does not convert every homeowner into a permitted solid-waste operator.
